results: For every k>=2 and q=p-k>=2, every minimum proper-star evaluation vector is a single (k-1)-star; every target has exactly k optimal one-target deletion patterns.
The second generalized Hamming weight is 4q+3, with or without the empty star.
Every optimal two-dimensional subcode is spanned by two adjacent (k-1)-stars; exactly 2^k binom(p,k) binom(k,2) such subcodes exist.
Every prescribed target pair requires exactly 4q+1 deletions if its signed intersection has size at least k-2, and 4q+2 otherwise.
The code results hold for all k>=2. Uniform overlap corrections are covered at power-of-two k. Exact nonlinear postprocessing of the same linear observations cannot improve these thresholds.
